metadata.source: PSOC - Suspicious Data Exfiltration Via Curl To Sendit.sh.yaml

metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.displayName: PSOC - Suspicious Data Exfiltration Via Curl To Sendit.sh
properties.description: Detects the use of curl.exe to exfiltrate data to the public file-transfer service sendit.sh using the form post flag (-F) and file upload syntax (file=@). This specific tradecraft was observed being utilized for data exfiltration in a 2026 Seedworm espionage campaign.
properties.query:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4688
| where EventSourceName == "Microsoft-Windows-Security-Auditing"
| where Process has "curl.exe"  // Process Name contains curl.exe
| where ParentProcessName has_any ("cmd.exe", "powershell.exe")  // Parent Process Name
| where CommandLine has_all ("-f", "file=@", "sendit.sh")  // Command contains all
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    Computer,
    Account = SubjectUserName,
    CommandLine,
    ProcessName = Process,
    NewProcessName,
    ParentProcessName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
